Student housing near VUB - investment decision
Valuation: 29 October 2026. All figures nominal, pre-tax. Hypothetical site; no investment commitment.
Base project NPV: EUR -3,705,688. Project IRR: 5.33%.
Best constructed case NPV: EUR -2,460,614. Selected NPV including no investment: EUR 0.
Do not invest: zero NPV dominates
Evidence and assumptions

VUB standard 2026-27 institutional room: EUR 449.30/month including services. Brukot city ordinary-room median: EUR 590/month including charges. Private residence rents can be higher. These do not establish achieved rent for this site.
Brussels property-specific reference rent and planning review remain outstanding. The 20% excessive-rent presumption is qualified, not a universal price ceiling.
Construction EUR 2200/m2, demand 125 students, elasticity 1.2, land EUR 1.5m and 4.5% borrowing are editable management assumptions, not observed site data.
Business model and reliability
Demand = 125 * demand shock * exp[-1.2*(rent/590 - 1)]. Occupied market rooms are capped at available rooms. Affordable rooms have separate prices and demand.
One period of development at year 0, twenty annual operating periods. NOI, replacement capex, debt amortization and terminal proceeds are separate. No corporate income taxes or tax shields.
Project discount rate 8%, equity hurdle 10%, common nominal growth 2%, exit cap 5.5% are unverified investor assumptions.
Managerial decisions - optimization and break-even
Capacity and rent: systematic integer search finds best built 120 rooms, EUR 650/month market rent. No-build remains available.
Maximum viable development spend at base operating economics: EUR 9,599,877. This is a ceiling, not a minimum required investment.
Undiscounted payback including sale: 19.027511499648725; discounted payback: Beyond horizon.
Optimization uses capacities 40-140, EUR 5 rent steps, floor area and budget limits, and 10% affordable rooms. A continuous global optimum and plot-specific feasibility are not claimed.
Sensitivity and uncertainty
Largest NPV swing over stated input envelopes: Hard cost EUR/m2. Comparing different ranges does not establish statistical causality.
1000 independent persistent triangular trials: mean NPV EUR -4,417,090, P5 EUR -6,114,118, P95 EUR -2,820,481.
Probability of negative NPV: 100.0%. This probability is conditional on subjective distributions, not a forecast calibrated to market history.
Cost factor 0.85/1/1.25; demand 0.75/1/1.15; opex 0.9/1/1.2; exit cap 4.5/5.5/7%. Triangular distributions reflect judgmental min/mode/max. Correlated adverse shocks and delays could worsen tails.
Affordability, sustainability and recommendation
Affordable share 10.0%. Affordable rent EUR 449.30 including services. At least 10% is an explicit management constraint; eligibility assumed means-tested enrolled students.
Illustrative annual operational carbon: 32.4 tonnes; energy 216,000 kWh. Energy and emissions factors are not measured or certified.

Obtain a secured site, itemized construction bids, achievable rent survey, pre-letting evidence, planning/fire/EPC review and lender terms before approval. Reject projects with nonpositive NPV or failed constraints.
Do not force profitability. Student review of financial assumptions, sources and formula logic remains required.
